value.rationale: The complete classification of square-zero derivation differentials on a natural two-generator truncated algebra determines a meaningful homological invariant and an intrinsic one-operation test for acyclicity, distinguishes dual-number cohomology from zero cohomology, and provides the finite-field mass distribution with asymptotic concentration. This is not merely a sample or an arbitrary parameter slice; it gives all differential outcomes for the first genuinely bivariate truncated plane. No general downstream theorem claimed.
